native_core_review_point.note: This report-only commit does not change runtime behavior; release evidence must bind the later exact candidate commit.

preserved_behavior.detail: Reader and Worker use Luna Max; Investigator uses Terra High; Solver and Advisor use Sol High; dynamic effort routing remains disabled.
Managed fresh spawns use fork_turns none and exact managed agent_type.
The canonical mutable workspace has at most one managed writer and unsettled or UNKNOWN ownership blocks conflicting takeover.
Host completion supplies candidate work only; Main verifies artifacts and WorkUnit ACCEPTED alone unlocks dependencies.
Managed delegation depth remains one and managed child profiles disable child multi-agent capability.
UNKNOWN cannot authorize replacement, conflicting writer transfer, or final acceptance.
Consequence-triggered Final Review remains fresh and exact-candidate bound; later artifact mutation invalidates the verdict.

intentional_changes.detail: Plugin Hook interception, orchestration_guard, Hook tool identity normalization, and Hook lifecycle correctness authority are removed. Native Host lifecycle truth plus Main reconciliation is authoritative.
PendingControl, Guard receipts, tool_use_id lifecycle authority, and request/receipt acknowledgement are removed without creating a replacement persisted control protocol.

Mandatory Host occupancy tokens are removed. Product fanout is initially at most 2 and normally at most 3; known Host capacity may lower that ceiling, unknown capacity does not block a bounded attempt, and Host rejection owns actual capacity truth.
The RC4 workload that could use observed native capacity for five authorized independent Readers is replaced by bounded product batching: initial 2, normal 3, queue the remainder.

The public product surface is reduced to exactly Orchestrate and Doctor. Preview, Status, Steer, Takeover, Continue, Correction, and related controls are intents inside Orchestrate rather than separate public Skill identities.
Execution receipts are current inspectable facts only. Persistent retry, rework, lifecycle acknowledgement, or control-history ledgers are removed.

corrected_regressions.detail: Native Core temporarily drifted Investigator from Terra High to Terra XHigh. The RC4 fixed profile contract is restored to Terra High across policy, managed profile, runtime projections, machine contracts, evals, and current product documentation.

Orchestrate Steer had been wired to post-completion focused FOLLOWUP semantics. RUNNING Steer now uses the native followup primitive without advancing control_epoch, changing lifecycle, reserving a new writer generation, or consuming focused-correction budget. Correction remains the bounded COMPLETED-child followup and Continue remains the INTERRUPTED-child path.

host_evidence_required.detail: The exact Native Core candidate must still pass the external N0-N8 Host campaign. Earlier RC4 and feasibility evidence cannot substitute for exact-candidate evidence.

N4 must probe explicit Host rejection of idle same-child followup or continuation. Source inspection shows Host can reject turn start before mailbox submission when execution capacity is unavailable; project behavior must remain fail-closed and must not create unsafe replacement or writer transfer.
N5 must probe explicit interrupt rejection and prove WriterLease remains blocking until current-generation Host settlement.
Configured read-only remains least-privilege intent only. The tested feasibility Host exposed broader danger-full-access behavior; N8 must report effective permissions from observation.

comparison_result.remaining_gate: candidate-bound N0-N8 Host campaign followed by fresh exact-candidate Final Review and release evidence verification
